summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a conference call to discuss first quarter 2026 results. No special situation is involved; this is a routine earnings event notification with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is purely informational regarding an earnings call scheduled for May 1, 2026.
